blocks.text: HOT TUB REMOVAL FAQ
Hot Tub Removal in Ajax — What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does hot tub removal cost in Ajax?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at the walkthrough based on the tub’s actual size and condition — there’s no extra charge just because a tub was built oversized.

items.q: Can you guarantee a hot tub is gone before our closing date?
a: Not in a way that complicates the process, just the pricing math. The crew sizes up appropriately for a larger tub and quotes accordingly, with the same one-flat-number approach as a smaller job.

items.q: Our realtor flagged our hot tub as something buyers won't love in photos — can you help?
a: No — draining is part of the service. No hose, pump, or prep needed beyond reasonably clear access.

items.q: We just bought a lot in Audley with an old tub on it — can it be cleared before our build starts?
a: Only once the power is confirmed off. A hardwired 240V connection needs prior disconnection by a licensed electrician.

items.q: Do I need to drain the hot tub myself before you arrive?
a: Yes — city-wide coverage from Springdale to Heart Lake to downtown, with the same crew and equipment ready regardless of location.
